title: Benchmarking PDF Accessibility Evaluation A Dataset and Framework for Assessing Automated and LLM-Based Approaches for Accessibility Testing

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.1: 'we used the most recent stable version of each model available as of February 2025 ... official APIs using default configuration settings (temperature=0.7)'

prompt.location: Appendix C (full zero-shot prompt for the alternative-text criterion); Appendix A Tables 7-13 (sub-criteria checklists inserted in the other six prompts)
prompt.note: Structured per-criterion inputs are described in Table 2 and shipped in the repo.

claim.metric: mean accuracy across seven criteria (3 runs)
claim.location: Table 3, column GPT-4 Turbo, row Average (0.85±0.04)

data.source: https://github.com/Anukriti12/PDF-Accessibility-Benchmark (modified PDFs, labels, processed inputs, pipeline instructions)

notes: Items per criterion are not stated explicitly (35 documents across seven criteria is quoted for the checker comparison; per-criterion accuracies such as 0.70 suggest more than 5 items); temperature 0.7 with 3 runs. Text-only GPT-4-Turbo received extracted structure/text rather than page images.

resolution.plan: The benchmark is 125 modified PDFs (5 base documents per criterion x 4 or 3 labels, Sec. 3.2.3), so n = 125 documents (3 runs each) rather than 35. The structured per-criterion inputs and the six prompts other than the alt-text one (Appendix C) are assembled by the repository pipeline; run gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0.7 for 3 runs and compare mean accuracy 0.85 +/- 0.04 (Table 3).
resolution.approximation: Sampling at temperature 0.7; 'most recent stable version as of February 2025' resolved to the 2024-04-09 snapshot.
